main_topics.reason: User came because zigzag lights before a migraine were new and frightening, and most turns discussed them.
User asked directly whether aura could signal stroke and said they were scared and their hands were shaking.
User wanted to know whether to go to the ER tonight or book a routine appointment, and asked for confirmation at t9.
User asked whether aura would now be permanent, and the bot answered over one exchange.
User asked whether aura could be a cue to take sumatriptan earlier and discussed it for a couple of turns.
User raised the birth control link and the bot explained the estrogen risk, but the user has not started anything hormonal.
User asked how to tell whether symptoms affect one eye or both, and got one answer.
Bot and user listed points to raise with the family doctor, and the user planned to book an appointment this week.

output.summary: A user with long-standing migraines described a new shimmering zigzag visual aura lasting about 20 minutes and feared it could be a stroke. The bot gathered details, explained how aura differs from stroke, gave red-flag guidance, advised a non-urgent doctor visit and covered sumatriptan timing and estrogen contraception. The user said they felt much calmer and planned to book with their family doctor this week and rest tonight.
